en: So long, Saejima-san. I hope to see you at the club again.
Uh-huh, see ya.
After seeing Kaguya-chan off, I began my pursuit of the mob.
Oh by the way, feel free to wander around. This is your imagination, after all!
Karaokekan is close by. You remember that place from your last date, right?
Oh yeah.
The mobsters were heading to Ramen Village on East Nakatsuki Street. If you want to chase them, go that way.
Saejima-san, what a busy man you are. You're late!
Hey, I thought we were workin' one of your cases?
Well, you see, on this particular night I had an after-hours date with my beloved Kaguya-chan. Together we walked to Ambitious, a local bar.
At least it ain't hard to imagine, this bein' the second time.
Yeah, looking real good.
So what's your tall tale today?
Well, now that you know I'm a former detective, let me tell you about a big case that I broke wide open.
Ya want me to pretend to be a cop while I'm behind bars? Odd notion, but I guess it's a change of scenery... Better change my look again, though.
It ain't the right garb for a cop, but...
It doesn't matter; just let me start the story! All right, it begins in this bar on Lavender Street. Let's go there⑬the place is called Ambitious.
Saejima-san, you're rather good at this game. I'm impressed!
Hah, why do you sound so surprised?
I win! Saejima-san, I must say, you need to try harder...
Yeah... you're just too good.
And so, Saejima⑬I mean, I⑬enjoyed a pleasant rendezvous with the lovely Kaguya-chan.
Don't pop up like that. Ya startled me.
But I have to reveal the true purpose behind my visit to this place!
Eh? What's that?
Go ahead and sneak a quick peek at that counter, my friend.
Who're they?
The Chinese mafia. My prefecture was keeping tabs on them.
An informant had just tipped us off about a weapons deal going down.
Look at them, the audacity of these guys! This bar was under Kitakata protection, and yet here they are talking business in it!
So you see, my date was just a cover. It allowed me to observe them up close.
Why not just partner with a lady cop? Be easier.
It needed to look real⑬those guys aren't <Italic>that</Italic> dumb.
Anyways, after a bit, they left. So I bravely went after them!
Is something wrong, Saejima-san?
Huh? No, it's nuthin'. Just gettin' late, is all. Let's call it a night.
Ooh, they have darts! And a pool table!
If you care to play, I think I'd prove quite the challenge for you... I'm pretty good at these games!
Let's play darts. But I'll tell ya right now, I won't be takin' it easy on ya!
Hehe, and neither will I take it easy on you!
Let's shoot some pool. But I'll tell ya right now, I won't be takin' it easy on ya!
What a great game! Now then, time for the Prize Roulette!

Akiyama and Shinada can use taxis to go to Sotenbori and Kineicho, respectively.


You cannot change your character in those cities.
You can now use New Serena as a hideout.
So, Haruka-san, have you ever done one of these handshake events before?
No, this is my first time.

I see. That's all right. Well, let me give you a little
rundown of how it's going to go.

To raise fan satisfaction level, shake hands with as many fans as you can before time runs out. At the same time, make sure to keep an eye on the staff member who keeps the line of fans moving along. Lastly, be on the lookout for super fans wearing happi coats. They can raise the satisfaction level more than regular fans, but if disappointed, they can also lower it dramatically.

While it's important to shake hands with each fan for as long as possible, the line must also be kept moving. This is the job of a staff member named Taro Hagashi, known as "The Remover." He discourages fans from lingering too long and removes them if necessary.

A fan who is removed leaves in fear, and the fan satisfaction level drops. Luckily, "The Remover" is also a big fan of yours. Use <Action:Button_L1@Handshake> to flash him a smile and he'll turn to mush and forget to do his job. You can use this to your advantage by smiling at the right time.

When the command to shake hands appears on the screen, hold down <Action:Button_Square@Handshake>. You will continue to shake hands with the fan until you release <Action:Button_Square@Handshake>. During this time, the fan will speak to you. Use <Action:Button_DPad_Left@Handshake><Action:Button_DPad_Right@Handshake><Action:Button_DPad_Up@Handshake><Action:Button_DPad_Down@Handshake> to choose your response. To raise the fan satisfaction level, choose the reply that matches the color of the fan's comment.

And that's about it... So, in a nutshell, we'd like you to
meet as many guests as possible in the time that we have,
and do your best to make them all happy.

The best way to make 'em happy is by shaking hands with each
one of them for as long as you can and carefully responding
to what they say.

I think you mentioned something about "removing," but could
you explain what that means?

Oh, that. Well, if a handshake goes on a little too long,
one of our staff will help move that fan along. In this
business, we call that "removing."

It's an unfortunate necessity due to the nature of the
event. What's more, fans who get "removed," of course, feel
disappointed and overall satisfaction drops.

You'll want to shake their hands for as long as possible,
but make sure you stop before they need to be "removed."

I see. Phew, there's a lot more to these events than I
thought...

By the way, that guy over there is the one in charge of
monitoring the guests. He's "The Remover."

Don't you worry! I'll defend your safety with my very life
if need be! Say the word, and they're outta here!

Huh? Uh, thank you... As long as you don't get too carried
away...

And that just about covers it. Would you like for me to go
through it again?
Yes, please, if you wouldn't mind.
Not at all! All right. Here we go, from the top.
No, thank you. I think I understand.
It's just about time. Thank you for doing this, and good luck!
Ah, Park-sama! Always a pleasure to see you.
How are you this evening?

(Wow! They know her name at an expensive place like this...?
She must be a regular.)
Today, I'm looking for an outfit for this young lady.
Very good, ma'am. In that case, what do you think of these?
Hmm... Haruka, I'd like you to choose.
Me!? You want me to pick!?

That's right. You can't just wear what someone else tells
you to wear. You have to develop your own sense of style.

So it's another step on the road to becoming an idol? All
right. I'll give it a try.
Shall we do your top first?
You know, blouses, sweaters, things of that nature...
Oh, my top. Yes, all right.
Very good. Do any of these catch your eye?
(I have to choose something...)
Um... I like this.
That's a nice choice.
Do you really think so? That makes me happy!

Well, everything in this boutique is high-end, so you really
can't go wrong in any case.
Now, shall we move on to your bottoms?
You mean pants and skirts and stuff, right?
You catch on quick. Go ahead and choose one of these.

(I have to choose something... I guess it should go with
what I already chose.)
I think this would go well with that top.

You're already thinking about mixing and matching, I see.
Very nice.
We'd also like a good pair of shoes.

Certainly. We have a lovely selection. What would you say to
something like these?
These are pretty...
Excellent choices. Everything will coordinate very well.

I can't say I exactly agree with all your choices, but
that's all right. We'll work on your sense of style over
time.
We'll take this as well.
Oh, it's beautiful...
And now, we're all set. We'll take all of this.
Thank you very much, Park-sama. One moment, please.
Oh! But I didn't even look at the price tags!

What did I tell you? Tonight is all about getting rid of
stress. You don't need to worry about a thing. It's on me.
Thank you very much, Park-san.
Here you are. My apologies for the wait.
Thank you. All right, Haruka. Shall we?
Woohoo⑬ Oops... I'm sorry, that was rude.

Phew... It certainly takes a bit of strength, doesn't it?
Your dance lessons must have built up your stamina. Your
sense of rhythm isn't bad, either.

But enough about work. That was really fun. Let's play again
sometime. You'd better be ready for me!
Oh, I lost!

Hehe, I can tell by your expression that you weren't holding
back. Give everything your all, and, win or lose, you'll
always gain something.

But enough life lessons. That was really fun. Let's play
again sometime. You'd better practice!
It's a tie!

Hehe, that was a good game. Even though it ended in a tie,
it felt good to give it our all, didn't it?

That was really fun. Let's play again sometime! You'd
better be ready for me!
What else do they have here, I wonder?

Oh, look. A PrintCircle machine. Let's try this, Haruka.
I've actually never done one of these before.
You and me, together?
What, you don't want to?

No, it's not that. I'm just... happy. I never imagined
spending a day like this with you.
...Who would ever imagine the president of Dyna Chair taking PrintCircle photos?
So how do we do this?
Let's see. Uhh, first we...

We choose some frames... There. How about these? Okay,
ready? Here we go!
Wait a minute. Where are we supposed to look?

Look, we're already on the screen. See? It's about to take
the⑬
What!? Why didn't you warn me!?
Ahaha! I did!
Well, that won't do at all! I demand a do-over!
Really? But they're nice pictures!
No way! Absolutely, positively not! A do-over!
Okay, okay. Ready? Here goes!
There. Much better.
Okay, and now we can add doodles to this picture. Like this...

These came out very well, I'd say. The machine even erased
the wrinkles on my face. I should hire this thing to replace
Horie.
Oh, that's terrible! Hehehe.
Hahaha! Ah, that was fun. Well, should we get going?
Yes, I suppose we should.

I haven't been to an arcade in years. What kind of games
are popular nowadays?

Well, some kids in my class were talking about Taiko No Tatsujin.
Oh, here it is!

Oh, look. It says two can play. Are you up for a little
friendly competition, Haruka?
Do you know how to play?

Well, I imagine you just hit the drum with the sticks, so
how hard could it be? Okay, yeah, let's try it!
But what about your hand?

Don't you worry about me. Besides, you're going to need all
the help you can get.
But you have to promise to do your best, or it won't be any fun. If you hold back on me because I'm the president, I'll dock your pay!
I won't! I promise!
We need liquor. As much as this will buy.
Uh, looks like I'm a little light. Could you fork over some cash as well?
Sure. I'm a little strapped myself, though.
You bought all the liquor you could.
You bought 10,000 yen worth of liquor.
Thank you, gentlemen.
What, are we trying to get a rhino drunk?
My pals will go through it faster than you think. Let's go find them!
Now that Kamurocho Hills is finished, they might be hanging in the Hotel District.

(Horie-san said he'd be back from the station in the
evening. Maybe I should try to sleep.)
(No, I'd rather be doing something.)
(I think I'll try to get some sleep.)
(No, no. I need to get to the emergency stairs.)
(I should follow Baba and head to the hideout he got for me.)
(I don't have time to take any detours. I should send the money at that convenience store.)

(Let's see. Horie-chan said the new girl should be in the
studio upstairs, didn't he?)
(Guess I better go talk to Kiryu.)

(They're worried about me... Maybe it's time I got back to
New Serena?)
(I think I'll enjoy the night a little more.)
(Friends, huh?)
(I have to go to Le Marche with Park-san now.)
(Well, since I'm here, I might as well take a stroll through Nagasugai.)
(This is a good time to walk around Sotenbori and explore a little.)
(Well, I got some time. I suppose I could take a stroll around Kamurocho.)
(Well, I might as well take a stroll around Kineicho.)
(Might as well walk around Tsukimino and check the place out.)
Up ahead, you'll find <Color:7>Ose Bridge<Color:Default>.
I'll be waiting there. Can you come see me?
Please. There's a matter that I must discuss with you.
All right. I'll see you there.
I'll be waiting.
(The rendezvous point, <Color:7>Ose Bridge<Color:Default> isn't in this direction.)
